name: The Sandman
description: After years of imprisonment, Morpheus — the King of Dreams — embarks on a journey across worlds to find what was stolen from him and restore his power.

videos.title: The Sandman: Unlocked
videos.overview: The cast and creators of The Sandman – Neil Gaiman, Tom Sturridge, Jenna Coleman, Boyd Holbrook, Vivienne Acheampong, Vanesu Samunyai, and Allan Heinberg – sit down with host Felicia Day for a full-spoilers discussion about the long-awaited adaptation.

videos.title: Sleep of the Just
videos.overview: While searching for an escaped nightmare in the waking world, Morpheus falls prey to Roderick Burgess, an occultist looking to summon and imprison Death.

videos.title: Imperfect Hosts
videos.overview: Morpheus begins his quest to find his tools of power — his sand, ruby and helm — by paying a visit to a pair of notoriously dysfunctional brothers.

videos.title: Dream a Little Dream of Me
videos.overview: Morpheus tracks down the last-known person in possession of his sand — and receives an unexpected lesson on humanity. Ethel pays a visit to her son.

videos.title: A Hope in Hell
videos.overview: A lead on the whereabouts of his helm compels Morpheus to seek an audience with Lucifer. A confused John receives a helping hand from a good Samaritan.
With Morpheus caught off guard, John settles in at a diner to watch the people around him — and put his theory about truth and lies to a terrifying test.

videos.title: The Sound of Her Wings
videos.overview: Feeling a bit rudderless, Morpheus shadows his hard-working big sister, who offers him advice and encourages him to reconnect with an old acquaintance.

videos.title: The Doll's House
videos.overview: Lucienne comes to Morpheus with disturbing news. Rose Walker goes in search of family. Admirers of the Corinthian's work scheme to get his attention.

videos.title: Playing House
videos.overview: As Morpheus closes in on one of his missing creations, Rose ramps up efforts to locate her brother — and unwittingly makes a friend's dream come true.

videos.title: Collectors
videos.overview: Odd disturbances shake up The Dreaming, Rose sets out on a road trip with a new friend, and The Corinthian arrives with a guest at a creepy convention.

videos.title: Lost Hearts
videos.overview: As the Dream vortex grows more powerful and the walls between the realms weaken, Rose must make a difficult choice. Morpheus confronts The Corinthian.

videos.title: Dream of a Thousand Cats/Calliope
videos.overview: In this two-part story collection, a Siamese cat dreaming of a new world and a writer in desperate need of inspiration cross paths with Morpheus.

videos.title: Season of Mists
videos.overview: When a gathering of the Endless exposes deep-seated grievances, Morpheus embarks on a mission to Hell to free the soul of a condemned mortal.

videos.title: The Ruler of Hell
videos.overview: Bequeathed the key to Hell, Morpheus throws a lavish banquet to determine which god, demon or faerie can be entrusted with its dark power.

videos.title: More Devils Than Vast Hell Can Hold
videos.overview: All the world's a stage as Morpheus summons history's greatest dramatist to perform an enchanting play for a supernatural audience.

videos.title: Brief Lives
videos.overview: Morpheus grudgingly helps Delirium search for their vanished sibling in the waking world — where a deadly force lurks in the shadows.

videos.title: The Song of Orpheus
videos.overview: To honor a promise to one sibling, Morpheus must shatter a vow to another. In ancient Greece, a wedding-night tragedy turns a son against his father.

videos.title: Family Blood
videos.overview: Morpheus enlists an expert in the occult to smuggle a deeply personal relic out of Paris — and help him and Delirium find the answers they seek.

videos.title: Time and Night
videos.overview: With the future of his realm at stake, Morpheus must appeal for help to an authority even greater than the Endless.

videos.title: Fuel for the Fire
videos.overview: Morpheus recruits a mortal agent for a dangerous mission in the waking world. A change of heart puts a pair of tricksters on a collision course.

videos.title: The Kindly Ones
videos.overview: Confined to his realm, Morpheus conjures up a new nightmare to do his bidding. The God of Deception deals roughly with an intrusive thorn in his side.

videos.title: Long Live the King
videos.overview: Fueled by rage, a grieving mother unleashes her wrath upon the Dreaming, as Morpheus confronts the Kindly Ones at the furthest reaches of his kingdom.

videos.title: A Tale of Graceful Ends
videos.overview: As deities, dreamers and demons unite to mark a momentous occasion, the Endless assemble for a family reunion unlike any other.

videos.title: A Special Episode - Death: The High Cost of Living
videos.overview: In this standalone episode, a journalist overwhelmed by hopelessness has a life-altering 24 hours after crossing paths with Death on her day off.
